test_title: PYST 03: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 07 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

He is waiting / at airport to receive / Mr. Smith, who is / coming from South Africa.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the omission of the article "**the**" before the term "**airport**."
 
• Singular countable nouns typically require an article ("the" in this context).
 
• The correct phrase should be "**at the airport to receive**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 4** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He is waiting at the airport to receive Mr. Smith, who is coming from South Africa."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "He is waiting," **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **2: "Mr. Smith, who is"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **3: "coming from South Africa."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **No error** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 4.
